Charity Commissioner dismisses complaint over 1989 Tata Sons share transfer

The Charity Commissioner of Maharashtra has dismissed a complaint regarding the transfer of Tata Sons shares in 1989. The complaint was filed by Vijay Singh and alleged irregularities in the share transfer process. The Commissioner found that the sale followed due process and closed the inquiry. This decision provides relief to Tata Trusts, which was involved in the matter.
